raw.details:
Overview

The Adaption Dataset Challenge is an online challenge run by Hackyard with Adaption Labs. Build an instruction-tuning dataset for an AI assistant serving an underserved language or domain. Use Adaption to create or improve the dataset, train a model with AutoScientist, and show the quality and usefulness of the result.

The theme

Pick a practical assistant use case. Example directions (suggestions, not required):

  • A question-answering assistant for an underserved language.
  • An assistant that explains a specialised topic or service in clear, accessible language.
  • A domain-specific assistant for a clearly defined group of users.

Explain who the users are, the problem you're solving and the assistant behaviour you want to improve.

How it works

  1. Define the use case, the intended users and the behaviour expected from the assistant.
  2. Pick or prepare a seed dataset. Public data or your own, as long as you have the right to use and adapt it.
  3. Prepare the data in a format Adaption supports, then create or improve the instruction-tuning dataset on Adaption's platform.
  4. Use Invent a Dataset and/or Adaptive Data. Record the methods, settings and iterations you used.
  5. Train a model with AutoScientist.
  6. Evaluate the dataset and model, and give evidence for any improvement you claim.
  7. Submit your dataset, model details, evaluation results and documentation.

What to submit

  • A dataset created or improved with Adaption.
  • A model trained with AutoScientist.
  • Your use case, intended users and assistant behaviour.
  • How you used Adaption: features, settings and iterations.
  • Evaluation results, with a baseline comparison where required.
  • A README covering approach, data source and licence, results, limitations and team members.
  • A demo of the assistant.

Dataset guidelines

  • Instruction/response pairs or chat-style data.
  • You must have the right to use and adapt the data, and name the source and licence.
  • No personal, confidential or unauthorised data, and no unsafe or illegal content.
  • Formats and size limits follow Adaption's docs and onboarding.

Judging

  • Dataset quality
  • Measurable model improvement
  • Relevance of the use case
  • Clarity of the write-up

Dates

  • Challenge launch: Nov 16, 2026
  • Participant onboarding with Adaption: Nov 18, 2026, 9:00 AM EST / 7:30 PM IST
  • Submission deadline: Dec 6, 2026, 11:59 PM IST
  • Verification and judging: Dec 7 to 13, 2026

Access and resources

Adaption will provide participants with the platform access and resources needed to build datasets and train models during the challenge.

  • Docs: docs.adaptionlabs.ai
  • Welcome deck and quickstart: open the deck

Prizes

  • 1st place: USD 100 cash and two VIP swag boxes.
  • 2nd and 3rd place: swag boxes.
  • Each member of the top three teams also gets an extra USD 1,000 in Adaption platform credits.
  • Every participant: a participation certificate.

Eligibility and rules

  • Fully online, open from anywhere. Participants must be 18 or older to use Adaption.
  • Teams of 1 to 4. Team-change rules come in the final participant rules.
  • You keep ownership of what you build.
  • Hackyard will share participant email addresses with Adaption for challenge-related account access, credit allocation and participation verification. Further details about data handling will be provided in the final participant rules and applicable privacy notices.

Questions: hello@hackyard.org
